facts.fact: The COMESA IDEA half-year report says Angola's IMA completed the Interoperability Framework study and its platform roadmap in January-June 2026, the basis for procuring the interoperability platform; it does not say the framework was adopted.
facts.system: Interoperability Framework and roadmap (Quadro e Roteiro de Interoperabilidade)

systems.country_label: Plataforma de Interoperabilidade da Administração Pública

facts.fact: IMA's terms of reference say a seven-month study with 25 public institutions produced the Framework and Roadmap of Interoperability, with organisational, semantic, technical and infrastructure guidelines and a phased roadmap; the document gives no adoption instrument. Dated by the document's publication date, 2026-02-09.
facts.system: Quadro e Roteiro de Interoperabilidade da Administração Pública

facts.fact: The same study found only 27% of systems interconnected across the 25 institutions, mostly point-to-point, with fragmented governance and no common standards; the document names no decree making the framework compulsory. Dated by the document's publication date, 2026-02-09.

facts.fact: Angola's Administrative Modernisation Institute (IMA) started work to define the National Interoperability Framework with Estonia's Digital Nation, funded by the World Bank's PADA project, said IMA director general Meike Afonso.

The Ministry of Youth and Sports reports that a workshop led by the Instituto de Modernizacao Administrativa (IMA) with Estonia's Digital Nation discussed a proposed national interoperability framework for public administration.
